question: How should one arrange his own purification from teacher?
premises: From teacher, austerity, mantra, and so forth, he should arrange his own purification.
Because it is said in Vajasineya, he should sprinkle body.
inference: Purification is arranged through teacher and ritual sprinkling.
plain_english: From teacher, austerity, mantra, and so forth, he should arrange his own purification; because it is said in Vajasineya, he should sprinkle the body himself.
